item.title: TOM BRADSHAW JOINS THE REDS
item.description: Barnsley FC are delighted to announce the loan signing of striker Tom Bradshaw from Oxford United, with the forward returning to Oakwell until the end of the 2025/26 season. Bradshaw previously represented the Club between 2016 and 2019, making 93 appearances and scoring 19 goals during his time at Oakwell. item.title: THANK YOU, DAVIS
item.description: Barnsley FC can confirm that forward Davis Keillor-Dunn has completed a permanent transfer to Wrexham AFC for an undisclosed fee. The move sees the 28-year-old depart Oakwell to rejoin the Welsh club, where he previously spent a brief spell earlier in his career. Since arriving at Barnsley in 2024, Keillor-Dunn quickly established himself as a key attacking figure, scoring 19 goals in 44 appearances during his opening season for the Club.
